description: This file contains implementation of the AMR speech codec encoder functions, including initialization, reset, exit, first frame processing, and main encoding routine. It manages speech analysis, LPC, LSP, VAD, and DTX processing, and handles subframe processing for speech encoding.

methods.name: cod_amr_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the state structure for the AMR encoder, including sub-states and overflow flag.

methods.name: cod_amr_reset
methods.description: Resets the encoder state to initial values, including pointers, vectors, and flags.

methods.name: cod_amr_exit
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the encoder state and deallocates resources.

methods.name: cod_amr_first
methods.description: Prepares the encoder for a new frame by copying new speech data into the look-ahead buffer.

methods.name: cod_amr
methods.description: Main encoding function called every 20ms to process speech, perform analysis, and produce encoded parameters and synthesis.
